title: On a Smoothed Walfisz Divisor Problem
summary: This work is in the spirit of our previous investigation on a smooth Dirichlet divisor problem, where we now replace the Dirichlet divisor function $τ$ by the sum-of-divisors function $σ$. We prove a totally explicit asymptotic formula for the sum of $σ(n)$ twisted by the weight $1-x/n$, which enables us to eliminate the difficult part in the classical average order of $σ(n)$. As a corollary, we deduce the convergence of an integral dealing with the error term in the Walfisz divisor problem.
